cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(imgui)

set(THIRD_PARTY_LIBRARY_PATH ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/external)

set(IMGUI_SOURCES 
    imgui.cpp 
    imgui_demo.cpp 
    imgui_draw.cpp 
    imgui_tables.cpp 
    imgui_widgets.cpp 
    backends/imgui_impl_glfw.cpp 
    backends/imgui_impl_opengl3.cpp 
)

add_library(imgui ${IMGUI_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(imgui PUBLIC ${THIRD_PARTY_LIBRARY_PATH}/imgui)
target_include_directories(imgui PUBLIC ${THIRD_PARTY_LIBRARY_PATH}/imgui/backends)
target_include_directories(imgui PRIVATE ${THIRD_PARTY_LIBRARY_PATH}/glfw/include)
target_include_directories(imgui PRIVATE ${THIRD_PARTY_LIBRARY_PATH}/glad/include)
